reference.title: Compression curves of transition metals in the Mbar range: Experiments and projector augmented-wave calculations

methods.source_location: Article section 2.1 and Supplementary Table S1 caption
methods.notes: Ruby spectra were measured immediately before and after each diffraction measurement for two spheres. NaCl volumes served only as a secondary check where peaks were present.

recalculation.notes: The exact Dewaele et al. (2008) ruby scale is executable in Peritheos and the reported source-scale pressures suffice for an EOS refit, but raw row-wise R1 wavelengths are not published.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.
qualifications: Phase-specific source inclusion flags are applied. This diagnostic does not replay the MINUTI volume objective and Gaussian parameter priors; a different conditional coefficient estimate alone does not establish a source-EOS failure.

fit.solver_message: Both `ftol` and `xtol` termination conditions are satisfied.

scientific_validation.note: The open publisher article and official supplement were audited directly. The complete source-scale P-V table and the versioned MINUTI equation, weighting, and selection protocol support an independent Peritheos refit.

locations: official supplement Table S1 and Figure S2
primary_source_check.finding: The source defines an independent 12-row, 300 K rhombohedral BM3 fit with V0, K0, and K0-prime all refined and no stated prior or fixed coefficient.
primary_source_check.record_note: Coefficients from Table 1 and Section 3.2, fitted with the MINUTI 2.0.0 program to the 12 rows of Table S1; the printed V0 = 9.59(10) Å³/atom is stored ×2 for one formula unit.

primary_data_check.finding: All 28 printed rows are preserved in the shared dataset; all 12 rows identified as fully rhombohedral are selected for this fit.

independent_refit.objective: MINUTI isothermal effective-variance volume residuals without priors
independent_refit.notes: Every refitted coefficient lies within the corresponding published marginal uncertainty. The rounded rows reproduce the normalized-residual pattern in Supplementary Figure S2; small statistic differences reflect rounding of pressure and atomic volume.

excluded_branches.reason: The 116.4 GPa SMS spectrum resolves approximately 37% low-spin iron, but no simultaneous P-V observation or complete spin-EOS parameterization is published.
Table 1's CMB model combines this work with thermal and velocity inputs from earlier studies; it is not an independently fitted EOS supported by this paper's complete primary P-V-T observations.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: article sections 2.1, 3, and 3.2; article Table 1; official supplement Table S1 and Figure S2.
parameter_provenance.equation: Article section 3.2, Table 1, and Supplementary Figure S2: third-order Birch-Murnaghan isothermal EOS fitted with MINUTI 2.0.0.
parameter_provenance.V0: Article Table 1 and section 3.2: 9.59(10) A^3/atom, freely fitted and extrapolated; multiplied by two atoms per Mg0.058Fe0.942O formula unit.
parameter_provenance.K0: Article section 3.2 and Table 1: K0T=217(19) GPa, freely fitted.
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Article section 3.2 and Table 1: K0T'=2.06(22), freely fitted with no stated prior.
parameter_provenance.volume_basis: Supplementary Table S1 and Figure S2 label volume as A^3/atom. The explicit primitive EOS basis contains one Mg0.058Fe0.942O formula unit and two atoms, so V and sigmaV are multiplied by two without changing K0 or K0_prime. No unreported conventional-cell metric is required.
parameter_provenance.temperature_ref: Supplementary Figure S2 identifies the isotherm as 300 K.
parameter_provenance.uncertainties: Table S1 gives parenthetical pressure and volume errors. Pressure error is the reported difference among ruby determinations before and after diffraction; the source gives no confidence convention for volume or parameter errors.

source_lineage.role: published EOS coefficients, phase selection, experiment, and pressure calibration
complete P-V observations, row uncertainties, and normalized-residual figure
source_lineage.citation: Dobrosavljevic et al. (2019), official Supplementary Table S1 and Figure S2

selection.excluded: All B1 observations, including the two pre-transition anomalous B1 rows

fit_provenance.objective: MINUTI weighted least squares in volume: chi2=sum((Vobs-Vmodel(P,T))^2/(sigmaV^2+(V/K*sigmaP)^2))/(N-n).
fit_provenance.covariance_scaling: MINUTI scales its inverse normal matrix by the minimized reduced chi-square; the article publishes marginal errors and error ellipses but no numerical covariance matrix.

superseded_record_text.notes: Published rhombohedral parameterization on the Dewaele-2008 ruby scale. V0 is stored on a two-atom, one-formula-unit primitive EOS basis because the source does not publish a complete conventional-cell metric. All three coefficients were free; no numerical covariance matrix is available.
validity_notes: V0 is a zero-pressure extrapolation for the high-pressure phase; it is not evidence that rhombohedral Mw94 is stable at ambient pressure.
The observed branch begins at 34.5 GPa after the B1-to-rhombohedral transition bracket of 30.1-34.5 GPa.
This is a structural branch, not a pure-spin phase-stability field.
